summary.text: Nate Butler is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 68 who has represented the district since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Butler, listed on Ballotpedia as Nathan Butler, is a U.S. Army veteran, realtor and pastor.

paragraphs.text: Nate Butler, listed on Ballotpedia as Nathan Butler, served in the U.S. Army for 20 years and reached the rank of major.

He earned a bachelor's degree in business from Wichita State University, a master's degree in administration from Central Michigan University and a master's degree in theology from Midwestern Baptist Theological Seminary.
His career experience includes working as a realtor with RE/MAX Signature Properties, as a pastor and as a consultant for pastors.
Butler succeeded Dave Baker in the District 68 seat and took office on January 9, 2023.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Corrections and Juvenile Justice, Taxation, and Veterans and Military committees and is vice chair of the Veterans and Military Committee.
